selection_rule: Only entries with status 'queued' are eligible. An entry is skipped when its approx_size_gb is above the protocol's max_model_size_gb. Eligible entries are ordered: first those whose developer has no measured build (no entry with status 'measured' and the same developer), then queue order. The first max_new_subjects_per_wave entries are picked. The choice is deterministic: the same queue and protocol always give the same picks. After a wave is collected and committed, the founder-approved session changes the picked entries to 'measured' with the wave noted. Set 'skipped' with a note to retire an entry without measuring it.
sizes_note: approx_size_gb values are approximate figures for the Ollama library tag. The real digest and size are read from the local Ollama (/api/tags) at plan time, and the plan refuses a pick whose real size is above max_model_size_gb.
